# Sendfox

Sendfox is an affordable email marketing platform for content creators. Manage contacts, create email campaigns, automate sequences, and grow your audience.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/sendfox/.

## Actions

- **Create Contact**: Create a new contact.
- **Create List**: Create a new contact list.
- **Delete Contact from List**: Remove a contact from a specific list in sendfox.
- **Get Automations** (read-only): Retrieve a list of automations.
- **Get Campaigns** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of campaigns.
- **Get Contact by ID** (read-only): Retrieve a contact's details by id.
- **Get Contact Fields** (read-only): Retrieve a list of user contact fields.
- **Get Contacts** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of contacts.
- **Get List by ID** (read-only): Retrieve a specific contact list by its id.
- **Get Lists** (read-only): Retrieve paginated contact lists.
- **Retrieve Contact by Email** (read-only): Retrieve a contact by their email address.
- **Unsubscribe Contact**: Unsubscribe a contact.
